VERDICT: LGTM

The tenure logic lives exactly where it belongs — inside `formatMembershipLevel`, the single method that already owns the membership-level computation, alongside the peer `format*` default methods in this mapper. No new unit was needed and none was wrongly introduced.

The structure reads naturally for this file: `owner.getRegistrationDate()` is already used by sibling methods (`formatAgeBand`, `formatMembershipNumber`), so reusing it here is consistent; the `level = Math.min(level, 3)` then conditional `level++` cleanly separates the pre-tenure cap from the tenure bonus, matching the Javadoc; and the `null`-guard on `registrationDate` follows the same defensive idiom as the rest of the class. Nothing is duplicated and the method isn't becoming a catch-all — it gained one cohesive factor of the same concern it already models.
